items.title: Why is China banning drone sales in Beijing?
items.title_zh: 中国为何在北京禁止无人机销售?.
items.summary: China is to ban the sale of drones in Beijing and permits will be required to fly them under new rules that take effect on Friday.
items.summary_zh: 中国将禁止在北京销售无人机,并且根据星期五生效的新规则,飞行需要许可.
